metadata.notes: Hosted Robert Nadeau (6th dan, USA) on Oct 27, 1990 — the day of the founding conference of the USSR Aikido Federation

metadata.kg_article_body: Robert Nadeau is an American aikido teacher holding the rank of 8th dan and master teacher in the Aikikai. He is well known as a pioneer in the energy and awareness aspects of aikido, having dedicated his life's work to understanding and translating these principles handed down by Ueshiba into fields beyond aikido, including psychotherapy, personal development.

russia_seminars.event: Founding conference of USSR Aikido Federation
russia_seminars.quote: On October 27, 1990, the day of the founding conference of the USSR Aikido Federation, Robert NADO (6th dan, USA) conducted a training at the Lenkai club
